text: ① Application form for International Students of Wenzhou Medical University. The form will be automatically generated after applicants complete the information in the online application system, and applicants should upload their signatures;② High School Transcript with the official stamp (scanned color copies of original or notarized copies in Chinese or English);③ High school diploma or equivalent certificate (fresh graduates can provide pre-graduation certificate first) (scanned color copies of original or notarized copies in Chinese or English);④ Passport within the validity period (Scanned color copy);⑤ Digital colored photo in white background (Format: JPG: 100-500KB);⑥ Financial guarantee certificate (parents' income certificate or bank deposit certificate);⑦ Foreigner Physical Examination Form: A scanned copy (the applicant should keep the original). The Chinese quarantine authorities issue this form, which must be completed in English. It is advised to choose the date wisely, for the results are valid only for 6 months;⑧ Applicants whose native language is not English should provide scanned color copies of proof of English proficiency (such as IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, etc., with IELTS no less than 6.0 and each band no less than 5.0; TOEFL no less than 70 and each band no less than 15; Duolingo no less than 105) or proof of a medium-of-instruction certificate in English during high school;⑨ A self-introduction video (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M) in English;⑩ Other supplementary documents as required by WMU.
